title: sophora japonica var. pubescens
intro: Sophora japonica var. pubescens, commonly known as the pubescent sophora or Japanese pagoda tree, is a deciduous tree species native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Sophora japonica var. pubescens are attributed to its ability to clear heat, reduce swelling, and promote expectoration. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
